create_game: create a StreetLearn game instance by name and config using CreateGame
apply_defaults: apply default configuration values to a partial config dict using ApplyDefaults
build_coin_game: build a coin_game environment with default and custom config settings
build_courier_game: build a courier_game environment with default and custom config settings
build_curriculum_courier_game: build a curriculum_courier_game environment with default and custom config settings
